explanations.45: This function converts single characters to lowercase (so 'B' becomes 'b') but leaves multi-character key names like 'ArrowUp' unchanged, because those don't have a meaningful lowercase version.
explanations.51: We use useRef instead of useState here because we need to track progress through the code sequence without triggering a re-render every time the player presses a key.
explanations.67: When you hold down a key, the OS fires multiple keydown events automatically; we ignore these repeats so holding arrow keys doesn't accidentally advance the sequence.
explanations.73: We call preventDefault to stop the browser from scrolling when arrow keys are pressed, so the page doesn't jump around while the player is typing the Konami code.
explanations.83: If the wrong key is pressed, we check if it's the first key of the sequence; if so, we set progress to 1 (giving that keypress credit toward a fresh attempt), otherwise we reset to 0.
